name: Shishinomiya Leporon
source:
Live big!
Lead boldly!
That’s the Prince of Leo way.

He’s big-hearted, loud, and full of energy! He’s a show-off who always wants to be in the center of attention. He likes gold and other shiny things, and his treasure trove is always sparkling. He claims to be the leader of the twelve princes of the zodiac, but they don’t seem to agree with him.
